content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Literate, preferably matriculate with a capacity of overall comprehension Other conditions: Preference shall be given to applicants who do not look up to the income they derive from services as PLVs, but should have a mind set to assist the needy. Desirable: Preferably matriculate

content_sections.heading: DLSA Barnala Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) Job Description
content_sections.text: The role entails working as a Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) under the National Legal Services Authority Para-Legal Volunteer's Scheme to assist the needy within the Barnala district.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: No salary or wages; honorarium of Rs. 800 per day fixed by the Punjab State Legal Services Authority, SAS Nagar. Vacancies may be increased or decreased as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Barnala Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Send it to Office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Barnala, by by post or by hand. Make sure it reaches by 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No application will be entertained after 30.10.2026 (05:00 pm). District Legal Services Authority, Barnala will not be responsible for any postal delay.
